description: Public-company 8-K filings filtered by item code or event type (M&A, executive change, financing, bankruptcy, or the default deal items). Each row has the item codes, a plain-English event type, a one-line summary from the filing, company, website and domain when EDGAR has one, state, SIC industry, parsed dollar amount when the text states one, and the sec.gov filing link. Missing values are null. Up to 50 events per call, date windows up to 31 days. Costs $0.01 USDC.

industries.description: Comma-separated words matched against the SEC SIC description, e.g. software, bank.

items.description: Comma-separated 8-K item codes or plain-English types (M&A, executive change, financing, bankruptcy). Default codes: 1.01,2.01,2.03,3.02,5.01.

minAmount.description: Minimum dollar amount parsed from the event text. Events with no parsed amount are omitted.

name: deal_events_8k
